welcome.title: A gentle reminder
welcome.m1: Your body fluctuates throughout the week, and that's normal. Water retention can change the number without changing your progress.
welcome.m2: One day doesn't define your journey. What matters is the trend, and you're staying with it.
welcome.m3: Thank you for logging today. Coming back to caring for yourself is already an achievement.
welcome.m4: Today's number is just one point on the path. Hydration, sleep and food are part of the picture too.
welcome.m5: Small variations are part of the process. Keep noticing your body with curiosity and kindness.
welcome.m6: You're building a routine, and routines are made day by day. This log is already part of it.
welcome.m7: You don't have to get it right every day. What matters is coming back, at your own pace.
welcome.m8: The trend is what matters, and it takes shape over time. Today's care counts toward it.
